meta.title: Wetherspoons Glasgow: pubs, menu and local price guide
meta.description: Compare Wetherspoons Glasgow pubs by area, find national menu favourites and learn how to check local prices before choosing where to eat in the city.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Glasgow across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose a location and understand what to check before ordering. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Find The Counting House, The Crystal Palace and The Hengler's Circus, alongside guidance on national menu favourites, local pricing, breakfast and club days. SpoonsMenu is an independent guide, not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc, so check current details with your chosen pub.
quickAnswer: This guide lists {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Glasgow across {areaCount} areas: The Counting House in George Square, The Crystal Palace in City Centre and The Hengler's Circus in Sauchiehall Street. Choose by the area that suits your visit, then check that pub's menu and prices rather than assuming every location charges the same.

areas.text: The Counting House is the listed Wetherspoons for George Square, with its address on St Vincent Place. It suits visitors who want a pub in this area rather than choosing solely by menu, which is broadly shared nationally. Check its current prices before deciding what to order.

The Crystal Palace is the listed Wetherspoons in City Centre, with its address on Jamaica Street. Choose it if this area fits your plans. Its location is a useful starting point, but the national menu does not mean identical prices, so check the pub's own menu before ordering.

The Hengler's Circus is the listed Wetherspoons in Sauchiehall Street, with its address on the same street. It suits anyone looking for a Wetherspoons specifically in this area. Start with the location, then confirm the dishes and prices you want rather than relying on another pub's menu.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Glasgow are set pub by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Any price shown in a guide should be treated as typical, not a promise of what your chosen pub will charge.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so a central location can affect the bill. That general pattern does not establish which of these listed pubs is cheapest, and you should not assume a dish costs the same at each one.

For the exact current price, check the menu for your selected pub or ask at the bar before ordering. If using the Wetherspoon app, select the intended pub before reviewing your order.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until midday, while [Steak Club](/steak-club) traditionally falls on Tuesday and [Curry Club](/curry-club) on Thursday at participating pubs. These are general patterns, so confirm service times and participation with your chosen Glasgow pub.

The traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu. For a club visit, check the current offer and local price before planning around it. [breakfast](/breakfast-menu) service times do not establish the pub's opening hours, and a club day should not be taken as a guarantee of participation.
